'''Clefairy's Training Camp!!''' (Japanese: '''はばたけ！　ピッピ男塾''' ''Swing Your Arms! {{tt|Pippi|Clefairy}}'s Private Lessons!!'') is the ninth chapter of the [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
{{PPM|Red}} has arrived in [[Petalburg City]]. He meets [[Roxanne]] the Gym leader, while she is carrying groceries back to the Gym. She invites Red inside and they find [[Roxanne's Nosepass]] studying.

==Major events==
* [[Roxanne]] meets Red and shows him and his Pokémon to her Gym which is also a school.
